name: f28m35h52c1_c28
description: TI F28M35H52C1 (Concerto) control subsystem: C28x + FPU32 + VCU at up to 150 MHz, TI C2000 code generation tools (cl2000, EABI), booted to RAM by the M3

image.notes: word addressed: word a is bus address 2a in the C28 map. c28.cmd puts codestart (LB _c_int00) at the RAM boot entry word 0x0, code in L0-L1, data in L2-L3, the stack in M1. The program is loaded but not started: the M3 starts it over IPC (or 'ipc StartC28 0').

renode.notes: Two CPUs in one machine (m3 Cortex-M3, c28 C28x): every address is per CPU; monitor reads name it ('sysbus ReadDoubleWord 0x20008000 m3'). The M3 boots through the M-Boot ROM stub to flash 0x00200030 and starts the C28 with the IPC boot command (MTOCIPCCOM 0x13, MTOCIPCBOOTMODE 1 = RAM word 0x0, 2 = flash word 0x13FFF0, MTOCIPCSET 0x80000001), or 'ipc StartC28 <word>'. Shared S0-S7 RAM: M3 0x20008000 = C28 word 0xC000. Pins: 'pins RecordPin n', 'pins PinFrequency n'. Docs: tools/concerto/PERIPHERALS.md.

reference.simulator: none; C28 peripherals shared with the F28069 models (tools/c2000), Concerto blocks checked with tools/concerto/tests
